=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: Online / Written Computer Based Test (Domain Technical + Aptitude)
• Stage 2: Trade Test / Skill & Practical Test (Qualifying in Nature)
• Stage 3: Document Verification & Pre-Employment Medical Examination

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. Domain Technical / Trade Subject | 60 Qs | 60 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Aptitude & Numerical Ability | 15 Qs | 15 Marks | 90–120
• 3. Reasoning & General Awareness | 15 Qs | 15 Marks | Minutes

• Exam Mode: Written / Online Objective Test (CBT) + Practical Skill/Trade Test
• Weightage: 60%–70% questions from concerned Engineering Diploma / ITI Trade
• Skill Test: Practical Trade Test is qualifying in nature

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Core Technical / Trade Discipline: Core Trade Theory (Fitter / Welder / Electrician / Machinist / Electronics / Civil / Mech), Workshop Calculation, Engineering Drawing & Safety Rules, Measuring Instruments (Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Gauges), Machines, Thermodynamics / Electrical Circuits / Shipbuilding Basics
• 2. Quantitative Aptitude: Number System, Fractions, Decimals & Percentage, Ratio & Proportion, Average, Profit & Loss, Time & Work, Speed & Distance, Mensuration (Area, Volume of Cylinder, Cone, Sphere), Basic Algebra & Trigonometry
• 3. Reasoning & General Intelligence: Number & Alphabet Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Blood Relations, Direction Sense & Seating Arrangement, Non-Verbal Mirror/Water Images & Figure Completion
• 4. General Awareness & English: Current Affairs, Defense PSUs & Indian Economy, Basic General Science (Physics & Chemistry Laws), Indian Polity & Geography, Basic English Grammar, Articles, Prepositions & Comprehension

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (TECHNICAL PSU) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• SBI Bank Security Officer  2026 Notification OUT for 60 Posts : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (60 Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (BANKING) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• SSC announces sub : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (BANKING) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• Central Bank of India Office Assistant  2026 : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (BANKING) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.

• 1. Domain Technical / Trade Subject | 60 Qs | 60 Marks | Combined

• 3. Reasoning & General Awareness | 15 Qs | 15 Marks | Minutes

• Exam Mode: Written / Online Objective Test (CBT) + Practical Skill/Trade Test
• Weightage: 60%–70% questions from concerned Engineering Diploma / ITI Trade
• Skill Test: Practical Trade Test is qualifying in nature

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Core Technical / Trade Discipline: Core Trade Theory (Fitter / Welder / Electrician / Machinist / Electronics / Civil / Mech), Workshop Calculation, Engineering Drawing & Safety Rules, Measuring Instruments (Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Gauges), Machines, Thermodynamics / Electrical Circuits / Shipbuilding Basics
• 2. Quantitative Aptitude: Number System, Fractions, Decimals & Percentage, Ratio & Proportion, Average, Profit & Loss, Time & Work, Speed & Distance, Mensuration (Area, Volume of Cylinder, Cone, Sphere), Basic Algebra & Trigonometry

• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.

• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

Form More Details, Read Official Notification.
• School Teacher (Class 6 to 10) : Graduate / Post Graduate in Related Subject with Minimum 50% Marks and B.Ed Degree OR Graduate / Post Graduate in Related Subject with Minimum 45% Marks (As per 2002 Norms) and B.Ed Degree OR 4 Year Degree in BAEd / BScEd STET Paper I Exam Passed Form More Details, Read Official Notification.
• Secondary School Teacher (TGT) (Class 9 to 10) : Graduate / Post Graduate in Related Subject with Minimum 50% Marks and B.Ed Degree OR Graduate / Post Graduate in Related Subject with Minimum 45% Marks (As per 2002 Norms) and B.Ed Degree OR 4 Year Degree in BAEd / BScEd STET Paper I Exam Passed (Subject Wise) Form More Details, Read Official Notification.
• Secondary School Teacher (TGT)-Special (Class 9 to 10) : Graduate / Post Graduate in Related Subject with Minimum 50% Marks and B.Ed Degree OR Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Related Subject with Minimum 45% Marks (As per 2002 Norms) and B.Ed Degree OR 4 Year Degree in BAEd / BScEd STET Paper I Exam Passed (Subject Wise)

STET Paper II Exam Passed Form More Details, Read Official Notification.

• Focus Area: NEP 2020, NCF, Inclusive Education, Pedagogy & Subject Mastery

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• Assistant Teacher (Primary – Urban) : Candidates must have a Graduation degree from a university established by law in India or an equivalent qualification recognized by the Government. They must also possess a recognized teacher-training qualification such as BTC, BTC (Urdu), Special BTC, 2-year Diploma in Special Education approved by the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI), 4-year B.El.Ed., or a 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed.) recognized under the NCTE Regulations, 2002. Candidates must also have passed the Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) conducted by the State Government or Government of India. Note: The BTC course is currently conducted under the name D.El.Ed.
• Assistant Teacher (Attached Primary) : Candidates must have a Graduation degree from a university established by law in India or a recognized/deemed university/institution, along with a BTC or D.El.Ed. degree from an NCTE-recognized course. Candidates must also have successfully passed the Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) conducted by the Uttar Pradesh Government or Government of India for Classes 01 to 05.

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Written Exam Interview (Viva-Voce) Document Verification
• Written Exam
• Interview (Viva-Voce)
• Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (SSC) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

Candidates must also have passed the Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) conducted by the State Government or Government of India. Note: The BTC course is currently conducted under the name D.El.Ed.
• Assistant Teacher (Attached Primary) : Candidates must have a Graduation degree from a university established by law in India or a recognized/deemed university/institution, along with a BTC or D.El.Ed. degree from an NCTE-recognized course. Candidates must also have successfully passed the Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) conducted by the Uttar Pradesh Government or Government of India for Classes 01 to 05.

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Written Exam Interview (Viva-Voce) Document Verification
• Written Exam
• Interview (Viva-Voce)
• Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (SSC) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• Bachelor of Design (B.Des) : Candidates must have passed Class 12th from any recognized board , including NIOS , or must hold a 3–4 year diploma or an equivalent qualification approved by a recognized authority. Applicants must also meet the prescribed age limit , follow the official guidelines, and be Indian citizens to apply.
• Bachelor of Fashion Technology (B.F.Tech.) : Candidates must have passed Class 12th with Mathematics as a subject , or they must hold a 3–4 year Engineering Diploma from a recognized institution . Applicants must also fulfill the required age criteria and must be citizens of India to be considered eligible.
• Master of Design (M. Des.) : Candidates must have a Bachelor’s Degree in any stream from a recognized university , or they must possess a 3-year Diploma from NIFT or NID . Applicants should also meet the prescribed age limit and must be citizens of India to qualify for the application process.
• Master of Fashion Management (M.F.M.) : Candidates must have a Bachelor’s Degree in any stream from a recognized university , or a 3-year Diploma from NIFT or NID to be eligible. Along with the educational qualification, applicants must also fulfill the required age criteria and be Indian citizens as per official guidelines.
• Master of Fashion Technology (M.F.Tech.) : Candidates must have completed B.F.Tech from NIFT or hold a B.E./B.Tech degree from a recognized university or institution . Applicants must also satisfy the age requirements and be citizens of India as per official rules.
• Bachelor of Design (B.Des.) For Artisan Category : Candidates must have passed Class 12th from a recognized board , including NIOS , or possess a 3–4 year Diploma or an equivalent qualification . Additionally, applicants must have a valid Artisan Card . Along with the educational criteria, candidates must also fulfill the prescribed age limit and be citizens of India as per official guidelines.

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: Preliminary Examination (General Studies + CSAT / Aptitude)
• Stage 2: Mains Written Examination (General Studies + Essay / Optional)
• Stage 3: Personality Test / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• Paper-I: General Studies (GS) & Current Affairs | 140–150 Qs | 200 Marks | 120 Minutes
• Paper-II: CSAT / General Hindi / Aptitude | 60–100 Qs | 100–200M | 120 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Offline OMR / Online Objective Prelims followed by Mains
• Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) or 0.25 Marks per wrong answer as per Commission norms

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Indian Polity, History & Culture: Indian Constitution, Parliament, Judiciary & Panchayati Raj, Ancient, Medieval & Modern Indian History, Indian National Movement (1857–1947), Art, Culture & State-Specific Heritage
• 2. Geography, Environment & Economy: Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India & World, Ecology, Biodiversity, Climate Change & National Parks, Sustainable Development, Budget, Fiscal & Monetary Policy
• 3. General Science & Current Affairs: Everyday Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Space & Biotech), National & International Current Events (Last 12 Months), Government Welfare Schemes & Census Data
• 4. Aptitude, Reasoning & Language: Comprehension & Interpersonal Communication Skills, Logical Reasoning, Analytical Ability & Decision Making, General Mental Ability & Class 10th Level Numeracy / Language

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (STATE PSC CIVIL) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (SSC) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (BANKING) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• Bank of Baroda  2026 : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (BANKING) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)

• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes

• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)

• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. === 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===

• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: Online / Written Computer Based Test (Domain Technical + Aptitude)
• Stage 2: Trade Test / Skill & Practical Test (Qualifying in Nature)
• Stage 3: Document Verification & Pre-Employment Medical Examination

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. Domain Technical / Trade Subject | 60 Qs | 60 Marks | Combined

• Exam Mode: Written / Online Objective Test (CBT) + Practical Skill/Trade Test
• Weightage: 60%–70% questions from concerned Engineering Diploma / ITI Trade
• Skill Test: Practical Trade Test is qualifying in nature

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Core Technical / Trade Discipline: Core Trade Theory (Fitter / Welder / Electrician / Machinist / Electronics / Civil / Mech), Workshop Calculation, Engineering Drawing & Safety Rules, Measuring Instruments (Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Gauges), Machines, Thermodynamics / Electrical Circuits / Shipbuilding Basics
• 2. Quantitative Aptitude: Number System, Fractions, Decimals & Percentage, Ratio & Proportion, Average, Profit & Loss, Time & Work, Speed & Distance, Mensuration (Area, Volume of Cylinder, Cone, Sphere), Basic Algebra & Trigonometry
• 3. Reasoning & General Intelligence: Number & Alphabet Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Blood Relations, Direction Sense & Seating Arrangement, Non-Verbal Mirror/Water Images & Figure Completion
• 4. General Awareness & English: Current Affairs, Defense PSUs & Indian Economy, Basic General Science (Physics & Chemistry Laws), Indian Polity & Geography, Basic English Grammar, Articles, Prepositions & Comprehension

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• Hamirpur police recruitment: 1,600 male candidates to appear for physical tests today : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (BANKING) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

• 3. Numerical Ability (Maths): Number System, Simplification, HCF & LCM, Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Partnership, Ratio & Proportion, Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Mensuration

• VTU Result 2026 Out : MSU Hall Ticket 2026 Out - Download Affiliated Colleges (UG & PG) Online @ msuniv.netlify.app 5 hours ago Dheshni Rani (As per Notice)
• VTU Result 2026 Out (Post Group 2) : AP SBTET Diploma Hall Ticket 2026 Out - Download Online @ sbtet.telangana.gov.in 6 hours ago Mahalakshmi Karunakaran (As per Notice)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: Online / Written Computer Based Test (Domain Technical + Aptitude)
• Stage 2: Trade Test / Skill & Practical Test (Qualifying in Nature)
• Stage 3: Document Verification & Pre-Employment Medical Examination

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. Domain Technical / Trade Subject | 60 Qs | 60 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Aptitude & Numerical Ability | 15 Qs | 15 Marks | 90–120
• 3. Reasoning & General Awareness | 15 Qs | 15 Marks | Minutes
• 4. General English | 10 Qs | 10 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Technical Exam) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 90–120 Mins
• Exam Mode: Written / Online Objective Test (CBT) + Practical Skill/Trade Test
• Weightage: 60%–70% questions from concerned Engineering Diploma / ITI Trade
• Skill Test: Practical Trade Test is qualifying in nature

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Core Technical / Trade Discipline: Core Trade Theory (Fitter / Welder / Electrician / Machinist / Electronics / Civil / Mech), Workshop Calculation, Engineering Drawing & Safety Rules, Measuring Instruments (Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Gauges), Machines, Thermodynamics / Electrical Circuits / Shipbuilding Basics
• 2. Quantitative Aptitude: Number System, Fractions, Decimals & Percentage, Ratio & Proportion, Average, Profit & Loss, Time & Work, Speed & Distance, Mensuration (Area, Volume of Cylinder, Cone, Sphere), Basic Algebra & Trigonometry
• 3. Reasoning & General Intelligence: Number & Alphabet Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Blood Relations, Direction Sense & Seating Arrangement, Non-Verbal Mirror/Water Images & Figure Completion
• 4. General Awareness & English: Current Affairs, Defense PSUs & Indian Economy, Basic General Science (Physics & Chemistry Laws), Indian Polity & Geography, Basic English Grammar, Articles, Prepositions & Comprehension

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined

• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

• Stage 1: Written Examination (OMR / Computer Based Test)
• Stage 2: Physical Standard Test (PST — Height/Chest) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET — Running)
• Stage 3: Document Verification & Detailed Medical Examination (DME)

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Knowledge & Current Affairs | 38 Qs | 76 Marks | Combined
• 2. Numerical & Mental Ability | 38 Qs | 76 Marks | 120 Minutes
• 3. Mental Aptitude, IQ & Reasoning | 37 Qs | 74 Marks | (2 Hours)
• 4. General Hindi / English Language | 37 Qs | 74 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Written Exam) | 150 Qs | 300 Marks | 120 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Objective Type Written Exam followed by Physical Endurance Test
• Negative Marking: 0.25 / 0.50 Marks deducted per wrong answer as per board rule
• Physical Requirement: Qualifying in PST & Running (PET) is mandatory

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. General Knowledge & State GK: Indian Constitution, Fundamental Rights & Police Act, History, Culture, Geography & Economy of India, State-Specific GK (Districts, Folk Arts, Rivers, Schemes), Internal Security, Human Rights & Cyber Crime, National & International Current Affairs & Awards
• 2. Reasoning & Mental Aptitude: Number/Letter Series, Coding-Decoding & Analogy, Direction Sense, Blood Relations & Ranking, Syllogism, Logical Venn Diagrams & Dice, Public Interest, Law & Order, Communal Harmony, Rule of Law, Professional Information & Police System
• 3. Numerical Ability (Maths): Number System, Simplification, HCF & LCM, Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Partnership, Ratio & Proportion, Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Mensuration
• 4. Language (Hindi / English): Varnmala, Sandhi, Samas & Upsarg-Pratyay, Tatsam-Tadbhav, Paryayvachi & Vilom Shabd, Muhavare, Lokoktiyan & Vakyansh ke liye ek shabd, Kaal, Vachya, Avyay & Ashuddhi Shodhan, Unseen Passage Comprehension & Famous Poets/Authors

• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

• CDS 1 2026 Merit List : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: Written Examination (OMR / Computer Based Test)
• Stage 2: Physical Standard Test (PST — Height/Chest) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET — Running)
• Stage 3: Document Verification & Detailed Medical Examination (DME)

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Knowledge & Current Affairs | 38 Qs | 76 Marks | Combined
• 2. Numerical & Mental Ability | 38 Qs | 76 Marks | 120 Minutes
• 3. Mental Aptitude, IQ & Reasoning | 37 Qs | 74 Marks | (2 Hours)
• 4. General Hindi / English Language | 37 Qs | 74 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Written Exam) | 150 Qs | 300 Marks | 120 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Objective Type Written Exam followed by Physical Endurance Test
• Negative Marking: 0.25 / 0.50 Marks deducted per wrong answer as per board rule
• Physical Requirement: Qualifying in PST & Running (PET) is mandatory

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. General Knowledge & State GK: Indian Constitution, Fundamental Rights & Police Act, History, Culture, Geography & Economy of India, State-Specific GK (Districts, Folk Arts, Rivers, Schemes), Internal Security, Human Rights & Cyber Crime, National & International Current Affairs & Awards
• 2. Reasoning & Mental Aptitude: Number/Letter Series, Coding-Decoding & Analogy, Direction Sense, Blood Relations & Ranking, Syllogism, Logical Venn Diagrams & Dice, Public Interest, Law & Order, Communal Harmony, Rule of Law, Professional Information & Police System
• 3. Numerical Ability (Maths): Number System, Simplification, HCF & LCM, Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Partnership, Ratio & Proportion, Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Mensuration
• 4. Language (Hindi / English): Varnmala, Sandhi, Samas & Upsarg-Pratyay, Tatsam-Tadbhav, Paryayvachi & Vilom Shabd, Muhavare, Lokoktiyan & Vakyansh ke liye ek shabd, Kaal, Vachya, Avyay & Ashuddhi Shodhan, Unseen Passage Comprehension & Famous Poets/Authors

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• UPSC CDS I Final Result 2026 declared at upsc.gov.in; 243 candidates qualify, check direct link here : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: Written Examination (OMR / Computer Based Test)
• Stage 2: Physical Standard Test (PST — Height/Chest) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET — Running)
• Stage 3: Document Verification & Detailed Medical Examination (DME)

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Knowledge & Current Affairs | 38 Qs | 76 Marks | Combined
• 2. Numerical & Mental Ability | 38 Qs | 76 Marks | 120 Minutes
• 3. Mental Aptitude, IQ & Reasoning | 37 Qs | 74 Marks | (2 Hours)
• 4. General Hindi / English Language | 37 Qs | 74 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Written Exam) | 150 Qs | 300 Marks | 120 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Objective Type Written Exam followed by Physical Endurance Test
• Negative Marking: 0.25 / 0.50 Marks deducted per wrong answer as per board rule
• Physical Requirement: Qualifying in PST & Running (PET) is mandatory

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. General Knowledge & State GK: Indian Constitution, Fundamental Rights & Police Act, History, Culture, Geography & Economy of India, State-Specific GK (Districts, Folk Arts, Rivers, Schemes), Internal Security, Human Rights & Cyber Crime, National & International Current Affairs & Awards
• 2. Reasoning & Mental Aptitude: Number/Letter Series, Coding-Decoding & Analogy, Direction Sense, Blood Relations & Ranking, Syllogism, Logical Venn Diagrams & Dice, Public Interest, Law & Order, Communal Harmony, Rule of Law, Professional Information & Police System
• 3. Numerical Ability (Maths): Number System, Simplification, HCF & LCM, Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Partnership, Ratio & Proportion, Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Mensuration
• 4. Language (Hindi / English): Varnmala, Sandhi, Samas & Upsarg-Pratyay, Tatsam-Tadbhav, Paryayvachi & Vilom Shabd, Muhavare, Lokoktiyan & Vakyansh ke liye ek shabd, Kaal, Vachya, Avyay & Ashuddhi Shodhan, Unseen Passage Comprehension & Famous Poets/Authors

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes

• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• WBSSC Group C and D Result 2026: Direct Link, Merit List : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• SSC CPO PET PST Result 2025 : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI

• Stage 1: Written Examination (OMR / Computer Based Test)

• Stage 3: Document Verification & Detailed Medical Examination (DME)

• 1. General Knowledge & Current Affairs | 38 Qs | 76 Marks | Combined

• Total (Written Exam) | 150 Qs | 300 Marks | 120 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Objective Type Written Exam followed by Physical Endurance Test

• Physical Requirement: Qualifying in PST & Running (PET) is mandatory

• 1. General Knowledge & State GK: Indian Constitution, Fundamental Rights & Police Act, History, Culture, Geography & Economy of India, State-Specific GK (Districts, Folk Arts, Rivers, Schemes), Internal Security, Human Rights & Cyber Crime, National & International Current Affairs & Awards

• 3. Numerical Ability (Maths): Number System, Simplification, HCF & LCM, Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Partnership, Ratio & Proportion, Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Mensuration

=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• UPSSSC Stenographer Result 2026 (OUT): Direct Link to Download Skill Test Merit List PDF at upsssc.gov.in : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

• RRB Section Controller Result 2026 Expected in December, Check Zone : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: 1st Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-1 Screening)
• Stage 2: 2nd Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-2) / CBAT / Typing Skill Test
• Stage 3: Document Verification (DV) & Railway Medical Fitness Test (A2/B1/C2)

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Awareness & Science | 40 Qs | 40 Marks | Combined
• 2. Mathematics | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 90 Minutes
• 3. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | (1.5 Hours)
• Total (Railway CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 90 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (Multi-Shift Normalized)
• Marking Scheme: +1 Mark per question | Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) Mark per wrong answer
• Shortlisting for DV: 1:1 Ratio of RRB-Wise Notified Vacancies

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Mathematics: Number System, BODMAS, Decimals & Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportions, Percentage, Profit & Loss, SI & CI, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Pipes, Mensuration, Algebra, Geometry & Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics (Mean, Median, Mode, SD)
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding and Decoding, Mathematical Operations, Relationships, Syllogism & Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Statement-Conclusion & Statement-Assumptions, Analytical Reasoning, Directions & Classification
• 3. General Science (NCERT 10th Level): Physics: Motion, Work, Energy, Light, Electricity, Units, Chemistry: Atomic Structure, Periodic Table, Acids/Bases, Metals, Biology: Human Body Systems, Diseases, Nutrition, Plant Kingdom, Environmental Science & Basic Computer Applications
• 4. General Awareness & Current Affairs: Current Events of National & International Importance, Indian Railways History, Zones & DFCCIL Facts, Indian Polity, Constitution & Governance, History of India & Freedom Struggle, Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India, UN Organizations, Space (ISRO) & Defense Programs

• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix

• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

• Paper 1 (Computer-Based Exam) Physical Standard Test (PST) / Physical Endurance Test (PET) Paper 2 (Computer-Based Exam) Medical Examination

Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI

• Stage 1: Preliminary Examination (General Studies + CSAT / Aptitude)

• Paper-I: General Studies (GS) & Current Affairs | 140–150 Qs | 200 Marks | 120 Minutes

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Indian Polity, History & Culture: Indian Constitution, Parliament, Judiciary & Panchayati Raj, Ancient, Medieval & Modern Indian History, Indian National Movement (1857–1947), Art, Culture & State-Specific Heritage
• 2. Geography, Environment & Economy: Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India & World, Ecology, Biodiversity, Climate Change & National Parks, Sustainable Development, Budget, Fiscal & Monetary Policy
• 3. General Science & Current Affairs: Everyday Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Space & Biotech), National & International Current Events (Last 12 Months), Government Welfare Schemes & Census Data
• 4. Aptitude, Reasoning & Language: Comprehension & Interpersonal Communication Skills, Logical Reasoning, Analytical Ability & Decision Making, General Mental Ability & Class 10th Level Numeracy / Language

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===

• 1. General Knowledge & Current Affairs | 38 Qs | 76 Marks | Combined

• SSC JE Tier 1 Admit Card 2026: Download Hall Ticket : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.
